journey: Read a quiet English chat, resize sidebars, and navigate a permanent project map into highlighted source and an L4SB dependency graph without inference.

implementation.chat: Long user and assistant messages fold; cancellation is an inline disclosure; work history opens from the composer. Both sidebars resize by pointer or keyboard and retain widths on reload.
implementation.graph_pipeline: Cached lexical source references or explicitly requested Atlas compiler extraction feed the shared declaration/edge schema. L4SB computes positions independently of review-scope coloring.

layout.default: One-hop dependency cone above and reverse-reference cone below; double-click recenters. Parent-angle ordering, adaptive radial spacing and polar Bezier links use the vendored MIT implementation.

implementation.review_scope: Explicit main targets, otherwise the focused theorem, seed meaning traversal. Known theorem-body edges can be excluded; definition bodies remain relevant. Unknown edges retain unknown scope. Colors confer no checked or proof authority.

large_inventory.behavior: Every source remains in the file inventory. Opening a file indexes it and follows import-only barrels through policy-bound reads; file-count map weights stay fixed. This is separate from bounded Atlas compiler extraction.

portable_english_migration.scope: Local translation of saved conversation/status prose and evidence captions, including nested JSON copies; original and English hashes retained.

outcomes: Quiet chat during held file inspection, followed by exactly one explicitly queued send
Long-message folding and sidebar drag/keyboard/reload/mobile behavior
Real installed Lean/Lake extraction, missing-root recovery and exact clicked declaration focus
Clone/restart, cancellation, provider failure and automated accessibility

decoded_screens_inspected: Provider 429 stop and explicit retry recovery

other_passed: Actual EthLib and Riemann browser observation

limits: No inference was used in the actual workspace observations. Automated provider responses are scripted, not live-model or cold-install validation.
Riemann is a source inventory and lexical navigation observation, not a whole-project Lean build or proof validation.
Atlas extraction remains explicit and bounded; lexical edges do not establish compiler dependencies or semantic certainty.
Inventory, file I/O, rendering and review colors are tested adapters, not newly refined controller or renderer proofs.
